newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended lower, hurt by late selling tied to technicals as well as concern that latest U.S. employment data showed hourly earnings rising, a factor which raised worries about further U.S. Fed tightening.

One Swiss-based trader said the Swiss market was under pressure after the June Confederate bond futures contract failed to sustain gains above resistance at 117.50. The Conf contract dipped to a new contract low of 117.10, and closed just above that level at 117.16. Volume was fairly heavy late in the day as prices declined, the trader added.
Swiss unemployment data are due on Tuesday, April 8.

Switzerland's Centre for Research of Economic Activity said its KOF barometer rose 0.1 percent in February from January for a year-on-year rise of 0.9 percent. Prospects for a slight economic pickupu in the second half remained intact, it said.
Euro Swiss francs gain one to 98.16.
